_about: Dugald Stewart (1753-1828), raw IA OCR: the Elements of the Philosophy of the Human Mind, as vols. II-IV of The Collected Works of Dugald Stewart, edited by Sir William Hamilton (Edinburgh: Thomas Constable, 1854). US public domain. Added in round ao: vols. I and V-XI of the same Collected Works (1854-1860), which with vols. II-IV completes the set; vol. V's year is garbled in the OCR and 1855 is inferred, and vol. VII is the copy with the Boston co-imprint of Little, Brown. No uids minted.
